Commentary.Commentary: Australia will back themselves to chase this. They will have to be careful about their shot selection, as they will remember their implosion from the series opener. Should be a good chase, if Pakistan can get a couple of early wickets and put pressure on the tourists. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.

The kangaroos did well on the whole. Got hit for runs at the beginning, but corrected their lines well and restricted the run flow. Coulter-Nile was the pick of the bowlers for his 3/18. Stanlake was a bit expensive for his 2 wickets and Short was quite economical, as he gave away just 16 runs in 3 overs for his 1 scalp.

A good comeback from Australia after the start Pakistan got. Zaman and Azam started positively, and the latter continued on despite the former's dismissal. Him and Hafeez scored 70 runs between them at a brisk rate but both missed out on their fifties. After that stand was broken and both departed, the runs dried up for the Men in Green and they couldn't even touch the 150-mark.

Well done, Tye. This is good bowling. Once again takes the pace off it, Ashraf doesn't pick it up this time and Ashraf is early into the swing. It goes off his thigh pad, falls on the off side and the batsmen cross over for a leg bye. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 147/6!

SIX! Goes big and that's gone all the way! Change of pace from Tye and Ashraf picks this up early. Rocks onto the back foot and muscles the heave over the cow corner for a maximum. Can he finish with a big one?
Too straight in line, Imad Wasim works it off his pads square on the leg side. Single taken.
Just a single on this occasion. Short of a length, Ashraf pulls it aerially over mid-wicket. Well short of the fielder in the deep, the batsmen cross over.
On the shorter side of things, pulled through mid-wicket for two this time.
FOUR! Good start to the over from Ashraf. Short ball, the left-hander pulls this aerially and sends it across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
No hat-trick for either. Back of a length, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Imad Wasim is the new man in. Coulter-Nile is on a hat-trick and so is Mitchell Marsh.

OUT! What a catch from Mitchell Marsh. The previous one was a simple one, but this one is out of this world. Full just around off, Hasan Ali goes after it as he has no choice. Lofts it high into the night sky towards long off. Marsh runs behind from mid off, stretches his hands out. Doesn't take it on the first attempt but dives and gobbles it on the second.
Hasan Ali is out next to bat.

OUT! Shoaib Malik is out of here! Full and just outside off, a bit slower in pace. Malik doesn't pick it up and that becomes his undoing. Mistimes the loft towards Mitchell Marsh at mid off who takes a good catch moving to his left.

Lbw appeal, but it's going down leg. Coulter-Nile comes from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle and leg. Ashraf looks to slog it across the line but is caught on the pads. The ball falls on the off side and a leg bye is taken.
Back of a length on middle stumps, Malik rides the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg. One run to the scoreboard.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, pulled down to fine leg easily for a single.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back.
Too full and wide outside off, Malik gets low to this one and lofts it over the cover region. Picks up two runs for doing so.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Ashraf swivels and pulls it through backward square leg. Single collected.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Overpitched outside off, Malik drills it through towards sweeper cover for a single.
Clips this length ball down to fine leg and crosses over.
Just behind a length, outside off, pushed on the off side for a run.
FOUR! Errs in line and pays the price. Tye bowls it on the pads and Malik just tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Faheem Ashraf walks into the middle next. Also, Andrew Tye returns.

OUT! GONE! Asif Ali is out of here. He had to go for it. Length ball on off, Asif stands his ground and slices it over cover-point. The man in the deep settles under the ball and takes a fine catch. Short is the man to take it.
Coming in at first and then straightening up shade, Malik defends after getting squared up. It rolls away square on the off side and a single is collected.
On the shorter side of the length, pulled aerially over square leg for one.
SIX! Right out of the screws! Back of a length on off, just sits up for the batsman. Asif Ali goes deep inside the crease and pummels it over wide long on for half a dozen.
Outside off, some room on offer, Malik opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Works it away with the wrists on the leg side for a single.
Billy Stanlake is called back on.
Too straight in line, Asif comes forward and flicks it through mid-wicket to get off the mark.
Full and outside off, pushed away on the off side.
Asif Ali comes in next.

OUT! Babar misses out on his fifty. Departs going for the big one. Looped up and around off, Azam clears his front leg and lofts it looking to clear long off. He can't, however, as he doesn't get the desired elevation on it. Down the throat of Aaron Finch who takes a good catch at the edge of the rope.
Short and wide outside off, left alone by Babar surprisingly.
Tossed up on leg, Malik flicks it off his pads through towards wide long on for a run.
Outside off, going away, takes the edge of Babar's hanging bat and runs down to third man for a single.
D'Arcy Short to bowl once more.
Pushed towards the empty spaces in the cover area for another single.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, pushed wide of cover for a run.
Jumps out of the track and hits it to sweeper cover. Another single for Babar.
Off the mark. Turns it away in front of square leg and gets to the other end.
Straighter one attacking the stumps, played out safely by Malik.
Ripper from Zampa! A bit quicker through the air, turns away from middle, Babar hangs his bat to defend and gets beaten. It goes off his behind square on the off side for a leg bye.
Shoaib Malik to bat next.

OUT! Hafeez holes out. Picks up D'Arcy Short in the deep. Short ball into the body, Hafeez pulls this with a lot of power. But, much to his misfortune, he hits it flat and straight to Short at deep square leg. Pakistan lose their second wicket.
Back of a length just outside off, Hafeez cuts and misses.
SIX! What a shot! Length ball outside off, Hafeez moves across his sticks, uses the pace and plays the pick up shot over backward square leg. Clears the leaping fielder and the rope there. Biggie.
Fraction straight in line, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Short and wide, cut fiercely behind point. Third man cuts it off and keeps the batsmen down to two.

Babar survives again. Could have dragged it on once more. Short of a length close to off, Azam looks to cut when there's no room. Gets an under edge which hits his pads and deflects just past the leg pole.
Billy Stanlake is back into the attack.
Leans ahead to this tossed up delivery and wrists it to long on. One run to end the over.
Decides to get to the pitch of the ball and defends.
Almost dragged it back on! Short, flat and quick around off, Babar looks to cut this away but gets an inside edge which just misses the off stump.
Zampa gives it air again, outside off, Hafeez gets low and lofts it to long off for a single.
Looped up in line of the stumps, Babar gives the charge and drills it to long off for one run.
Turning away from outside off, Hafeez rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover to get off strike.
Almost! So close. Tye takes the pace off this one and bowls it full, Hafeez chips it to the left of the bowler. Tye sticks his hand out but it goes past him. Single taken.
Babar comes forward to this full length ball and pushes it into the covers for one.
Fires it right up there, on the stumps, eased down through mid on and gets to the other end.
Fraction straight in line, flicked it away through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Length delivery outside the line of off stump, run down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length on the hips, Hafeez waits for it and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Floated up on off, driven to long on for a single.
Driven through mid on by Azam. A single is collected.

Good effort from Tye in the deep. Babar Azam lofts this over mid-wicket. Tye from wide long on covers a lot of ground to his right, slides as the ball falls short of him but does well to stop it from going past him. Two added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. Two runs added to the total.
Short ball in line of the stumps, pulled through to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full in length and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman through mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Dropped! Difficult chance though. Short on the stumps, Hafeez goes on the back foot and pulls it aerially towards long on. The fielder there runs in, dives forward to get his fingertips on it but can't hold on. A single to the total.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Short and flat outside off, cracked off the back foot through covers for a run.
Looped up leg break, driven towards the cover area. No run taken.
Gives the charge once more, it's floated outside off, chips it towards long off for a single.
Babar Azam comes down the track and works it with the turn through mid-wicket. One run to the total.
Flicks it with the wrists through mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it right up there, on the stumps, wristed back in the bowler's direction.
Too straight on the pads, turned towards short fine leg.
Short again, Hafeez goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter in length, on the stumps, worked away through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside of, cut straight to point.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. One run added to the total.
Outside off, pushed towards third man for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
SIX! Fine shot! On a length outside off, Hafeez jumps out and lofts it over long off!
Outside off, left alone.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
RUN OUT MISSED. Azam works it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a single. However, on seeing Maxwell, he sends Hafeez back who is gone for all money. But Maxi misses.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A slower ball, but on the pads. Paddled past short fine leg.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
On the pads, flicked away for a single.
An off cutter now, pushed towards point again.
Outside off, played straight to point.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.
ANOTHER WIDE, down the leg side again.
WIDE. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Pushes this through mid on for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, Hafeez slashes but misses.
FOUR! Down the leg side, a length ball, pulled through square leg.
Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Outside off, Azam steers it behind point for a boundary!
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. One run added to the total. Leg bye given by the umpire.
Pushes this through mid on for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Mohammad Hafeez walks in at number 3.

OUT! Given out on review! Short ball, Zaman looks to pull but seemingly he misses. Carey collects and appeals but the umpire stays put. Finch then takes the review and Snickometer detects a spike when the ball passes the bat! One down then, Pakistan.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, hammered towards mid off for a quick run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Nicely done. A short ball, around off, Babar swivels and pulls it behind square leg.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
FOUR! Lucky. Full and outside off, Zaman swings hard but only gets a thick inside edge past the stumps towards fine leg for a boundary!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
The batsman has been hit on the glove or forearm.
Outside off, short in length, Zaman looks to cut but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They manage to come back for the second.
Outside off, tapped towards cover for a quick single.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Azam leans into this one and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Full and outside off, sliced over mid off for a brace.
On middle and leg, helped around the corner for a run.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. One run added to the total. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on for a single.
We are all set for the second T20I.
